title: 1702-MX attachments are saved and reloaded
about: When a 1702-MX return has more than one exempt or special-rate activity, BIR copies its attachment pages once per activity and turns their hidden boxes into text boxes so they are saved. It finds those boxes by the text type=hidden, which is how old Internet Explorer wrote the page back. Newer browsers write type="hidden" with quotes, so no box was found, the attachments stayed hidden and nothing in them was saved. This accepts both spellings.
